description: Exact resume P0 (docs/tp4-exact-resume.md 5.2): a returning sticky turn resumes at floor2048(P) instead of floor2048(P) - 2048. QWEN_PREFIX_STICKY_UNDROP=1 lifts vLLM's EAGLE last-block drop for the hit lookup (the scheduler graft) and plans floor2048(P); QWEN_PREFIX_WINDOW_CARRY=1 files the drafter window rows below floor2048(P) on that checkpoint (prefix_window_carry) so a turn with less than 2048 - (P mod 2048) new tokens may resume above P' - 2048 too; QWEN_PREFIX_WINDOW_CARRY_AUDIT=1 reads the carried rows back and digests every sticky window for the cold-twin comparison. Byte-exact (E0): the same chunk-program checkpoints, one chunk higher, and the cold window's own rows. Plus the turn telemetry (counts only, on unless QWEN_PREFIX_TURN_TELEMETRY=0) and the Phase-0 split-invariance probe (C2_FABRIC_PROBE=split, runs from the checkout on an existing image).

profiles.name: all-er
profiles.reason: exact resume P0 on the combined arm: the undrop and the drafter-window carry; the timed arm of the returning-turn ABAB ERC1/ERL1/ERC2/ERL2 (the control is -fx-all itself, same plans). Est. -0.5 / -0.8 / -1.3 s first-token time per typical tool turn at 32k / 128k / 254k (docs/tp4-exact-resume.md 4.3).

profiles.name: all-er-audit
profiles.reason: the audited twin: every fx-all lever with its audit plus the carry's audit (the carried rows read back against the stored bytes, every sticky window's digest for the gate's cold-twin comparison); the audited attach ERA and the exactness arm ERX. Not a timing arm.

smoke.what: exact resume P0: the undrop and the drafter-window carry (the scheduler graft's install line; a smoke sends no salt, so the carried admissions and the audit are the prefix gate's)

image_files.reason: the carry's fast-path half: export of the window rows after a sticky prefill, the carried rows' upload and audit (imported lazily by serving_lifecycle and dflash_prefill_window's capture under QWEN_PREFIX_WINDOW_CARRY)

card_jobs: scripts/ci/references/fusion-jobs/ER (ORDER.txt there): SP0 the split-invariance probe on an existing image (no build), then B0 X0 ERA ERX ERC1 ERL1 ERC2 ERL2 [ERB1 ERB2] Z on the image built from this branch.
